identity.name: Santos de Cartier

case.bezel: steel bezel with exposed screws (signature Santos design)

identity.one_liner: The medium-size version of the 2018 Santos relaunch, sharing the large model's exposed-screw case and quick-change bracelet in a smaller footprint.

narrative.story: The medium Santos de Cartier shares the 2018 relaunch's case architecture, exposed bezel screws, and QuickSwitch/SmartLink bracelet system with the large model, scaled to a 35.1mm case that fits a wider range of wrists than the 39.8mm large version.
narrative.collector_notes: Medium and large Santos cases are not simply scaled copies of the same parts — bracelets and some case components are sized specifically to each and are not interchangeable between the two.
